template.name: Masimo Rad-G Pulse Oximeter
template.desc: Masimo Rad-G handheld pulse oximeter, tested on its charger as Class II (the Ansur template is “AS/NZS 3551 - CL2”): no protective earth or earth leakage. From the CHS Ansur template “Masimo Rad-G AS-NZS 3551 EST and PVT”. Electrical safety to AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2: insulation mains–accessible parts over 1 Mohm, enclosure 100/500/500 µA. Applied parts type BF on RA, as the Ansur records measured them (patient leakage 100/500 µA, mains on applied parts 5000 µA); the Ansur template also listed CF limits that were not applied. SpO2 readings keep the Ansur limits.

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Inspect the monitor, cables and accessories.

items: The case, display screen, buttons, power cord, and accessories have no obvious signs of damage.
The external connecting cables are not frayed and the connector pins are not loose or bent.
The external connectors are not loose and their pins are not bent.
The safety labels and data plate are clearly legible.
The power-on test is passed. The power indicator and alarm system works correctly and the monitor starts up properly.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply you are testing from.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to accessible parts
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Plug the Rad-G charger into the ESA612 equipment outlet with the Rad-G connected. Clip the red test lead to foil wrapped around the Rad-G.

steps.title: Patient leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the SpO2 sensor (wrapped in foil, or its cable connector pins linked) to the ESA612 RA post. Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: Mains on applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect the SpO2 sensor (wrapped in foil, or its cable connector pins linked) to the ESA612 RA post. Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions:
Connect the red test lead to foil wrapped around the Rad-G (it stays on its charger, plugged into the ESA612 equipment outlet).
Note: only a representative sample of conductive non-earthed exposed parts needs to be tested.

steps.title: SpO2
steps.instructions:
1. Measure SpO2 on a healthy person’s finger: a Pleth wave and PR value are displayed. Enter the SpO2.
2. Measure on the SpO2 simulator set to 95 %: a Pleth wave and PR value are displayed. Enter the SpO2.

items: A Pleth wave and PR value are displayed.

readings.label: Displayed SpO2 on a healthy finger (95–100 %)
Displayed SpO2 with the simulator at 95 % (94–96 %)

steps.title: Temperature
steps.instructions: Only if the Rad-G has temperature; otherwise mark the item N/A.

items: The monitor displays a temperature value.
The monitor operates correctly from battery power when external AC power fails.
The operating time of the battery meets the product specification.
